g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
What to check when a PDF will not upload to Gemini
Notebook: file size, word count, and copy protection
first
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-11-11
Check the file size and word count
first
The official Help documentation limits a single
source to 500,000 words or fewer and local file
uploads to 200 MB or less.
Check whether the PDF is
copy-protected
The Help documentation states that importing may
fail if the original PDF is copy-protected.
If it is a scan, check whether the
text is actually present
If the text exists only as images, as in a PDF
made from photographs, there may be less body
text available for answers.
Narrow the question scope after
importing
According to the Help documentation, sources are
always used for questions, and answers are based
on either all sources or selected sources.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
